newsitem.title: USA: NOTICE OF SALE - Oakland, Calif..
newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Oakland, Calif..

text.p: NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN that sealed bids will be received by the Interim Assistant City Manager, acting on behalf of the City of Oakland, California (the City''), for the purchase of $60,000,000* principal amount of City of
Oakland, California 1997 Tax and Revenue Anticipation Notes (the Notes'') at the hour of 11:00 A.M., California Time, on

(or at such other time and date as may be communicated by the City through Munifacts News Service at least 24 hours prior to the time that bids are to be received) at the offices of Public Financial Management, Inc., 505 Montgomery Street, Suite 800, San Francisco, CA 94111. In the event that no bid is awarded at the scheduled time and date, the City will receive bids at such other time and date as may

be communicated by the City through Munifacts News Service at least 24 hours prior to the time that bids are to be received until such time as a bid is awarded or the City determines to withdraw sale of the Notes. Information regarding the Notes and sale of the Notes may be obtained from Priva Mathur at Public Financial Management, Inc. at (415) 982-5544.
